reproduction.code:
# Biology reviewer independent verification (executed in this review run)
import json, hashlib, math

# 1) Hash actual attachment bytes
for fn in ['context.json','source-1CRN.pdb','sasa.json','synthesis.json']:
    b = open(fn,'rb').read()
    print(fn, hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(), len(b))

# 2) Parse frozen PDB: heavy ATOM, altLoc blank/A, no HETATM/hydrogens
atoms=[]; elements={}; residues=set()
for line in open('source-1CRN.pdb'):
    if line.startswith('ATOM'):
        el=line[76:78].strip()
        if el=='H': continue
        if line[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        atoms.append(line[12:16].strip())
        elements[el]=elements.get(el,0)+1
        residues.add((line[21],line[22:26].strip(),line[17:20].strip()))
print('heavy ATOM count', len(atoms))
print('elements', elements)
print('residue count', len(residues))

# 3) Verify sasa.json residue sums vs totals
sasa=json.load(open('sasa.json'))['result']
for k in ['n1000','n5000']:
    run=sasa['runs'][k]
    s=sum(r['area_A2'] for r in run['residues'])
    print(k,'residue_sum',s,'total',run['total_A2'],'residual',s-run['total_A2'])

# 4) Verify convergence
t1000=sasa['runs']['n1000']['total_A2']; t5000=sasa['runs']['n5000']['total_A2']
ratio=abs(t1000-t5000)/t5000
print('convergence ratio', ratio, '<=0.02', ratio<=0.02)
